title: New player defaults check (DPC 0.9.172-dev51, Camera Distance 2.9.18-dev4)
intro: Settings reset to the defaults for this check (your own are saved and can be put back). Playing the Arisen, co-op off, a full party with an Archer pawn, a second controller for co-op. Each step waits for End.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.fresh: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.cfg.switch_cine_glow_s == 1.8 and D.cfg.coop_glow_keep == true and D.cfg.cheat_free_arrows == true) or false
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_name) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; if D.coop.active then return 'classic' end; return 'off'
probes.dead: local pm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l = pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not l then return 0 end; local n = 0; for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do local c = l:call('get_Item', i); if c and c:call('get_IsDead') then n = n + 1 end end; return n

steps.text: Get ready: playing the Arisen, co-op off, full party (one Archer pawn helps), open ground. Settings are back to the defaults (yours are saved). Press End.
PLAYING A PAWN: take control of a pawn (L1 + left stick click, or F6). Watch the switch (camera move and green glow). Walk, sprint (hold), use a skill. Is the default switch nice? End when done.

BOW: switch to your Archer pawn (L1 + left stick click again) and try the special-arrow skills and Spiral Arrow / Heavenly Shot from the hip. They should all fire. Then go back to the Arisen. End when done.

CO-OP: on the Arisen (controller or keyboard), a friend holds L3 + R3 on another controller. Glows, markers, both right sticks turn the camera, flick to switch targets. Walk to a wall or cliff and climb something if handy. Feel right out of the box? End when done.
DOWN: one of the other pawns is knocked down now: the game's chime and flash, and he lies there. Revive him straight away. End when done.
End co-op (player 1: Ctrl + F6, or hold L3 + R3 for 3 s on player 1's controller). Anything you'd change as a new player? End when done.
Done. Tell Claude anything that felt off with the defaults.
